Jordan P.: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands 1 can we clarify a few GTM points so teams can act?
Mei Zhang: Yep. Shoot the list.
Jordan P.: 1) Where does the sales handbook live now (handbook v2 mention in the deck)? 2) For partner-led deals, what counts as "influenced" vs "attributed"? 3) Any roadmap timing changes for the partner portal?
Oliver K.: 1) Handbook v2 is in Notion: /handbook/sales-v2 (private). Ops will share a read-only export for wider distribution.
Rachel S.: 2) Influenced = any opp where partner did intro or provided >1 joint engagement. Attributed = partner is primary lead in CRM and marked as "partner_source" on close. We track both.
Mei Zhang: 3) Partner portal ETA slipped to late Oct for initial beta (we had a dependency on SSO work). Roadmap note will be updated and posted.
Jordan P.: Thanks. A few operational asks: ops, can you publish a one-pager for the renewal triage fields we should pull? Sales wants a minimal template.
ops-bot: Action: publish renewal-triage-template.md to /ops/documents by Mon 09:00 PT. Reminder set.
Oliver K.: Also adding: for partner incentives, comp team will confirm whether referral credits apply to ARR or ACV this week.
Rachel S.: Comp note: attribution affects commission. Ops and Comp will sync on cutoffs and share before next sprint planning.
Jordan P.: Routing question: if a partner-originated opp scales >$100k but partner still active, who owns relationship?
Mei Zhang: During Q3 pilot, keep partner as primary and field AE in supporting role. We'll revisit handoff rules after pilot results.
Oliver K.: I'll add a short joint-owner checklist to the handbook v2 for clarity.
Jordan P.: Action list then: 1) Ops -> publish renewal triage template and handbook export (Mon). 2) Comp -> finalize referral credit basis (this week). 3) Partnerships -> update partner portal ETA in roadmap and share beta sign-up. 4) Sales -> tag #partners early and set partner_source in CRM on close.
ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: ops deliverables due Mon 09:00 PT.
Rachel S.: Thanks all 10 I'll coordinate comp sync.
Jordan P.: Appreciate the quick responses. If no objections I'll send this summary to the exec thread.
Mei Zhang: No objections, go ahead.
